Sample `.fit` activities from the test suite of the `fitparser` crate
(https://github.com/stadelmanma/fitparse-rs, MIT licence), used by the unit
tests in `src/fit.rs`:

- `Activity.fit` — a short run with no heart rate.
- `garmin-fenix-5-bike.fit` — a ride from a Garmin Fenix 5, with heart rate and
  a sport profile name.
